name: chain chausses
_design_note: F20-70 medium legs slot. Mail leg covering, traditionally paired with hauberk. Covers chain_leggings, iron_leggings, scale_greaves from legacy data.
lore_template: These {material_name} chausses are leggings of mail, hung from the belt and gathered at the ankle. Knights wore them beneath a hauberk, so that the rings ran unbroken from collarbone to shin, and they turn most cuts while yet allowing a full stride.
